description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AmazonApiGatewayManagementApi service, providing methods for managing WebSocket connections such as deleteConnection, getConnection, and postToConnection, including their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: ApiGatewayManagementApiClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AmazonApiGatewayManagementApi, extending AwsClient and providing specific methods for connection management.

methods.name: deleteConnection
methods.description: Deletes a WebSocket connection identified by the provided parameters.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnection
methods.description: Posts a message to a specific WebSocket connection.

methods.name: postToConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously posts a message to a WebSocket connection.
